visual.detailed_description: One unlabelled color photograph of the umbilical region showing a raised, lobulated pink to pink-white mass with yellow-tan crusting and an orange-brown area, on pale abdominal skin. No panel letters, scale, text labels or numeric values are visible.

panels.general_description: Color close-up photograph of a lobulated pink mass filling the umbilicus on pale abdominal skin.
panels.detailed_description: A single color close-up photograph of the umbilical region. A raised, multi-lobulated pink to pink-white mass with smooth rounded lobules fills the umbilicus and protrudes from it. Yellow-tan crusted or scaly material covers parts of the surface, with an orange-brown area in the central and right-hand portion and a tiny dark speck near the center. Pale beige skin with fine creases surrounds the lesion. No ruler, scale bar, panel letter, text label, annotation or numeric value is visible.
